text: The purpose of this report is to appoint a qualified person to the office of Councillor, Ward 10, Spadina-Fort York.

City Council on June 1, 2022, appointed Joe Mihevc to the Office of Councillor, Ward 10, Spadina-Fort York, for the remainder of this term of Council. City Council also appointed Joe Mihevc to the following, effective June 1, 2022: a. the Economic and Community Development Committee for a term of office until November 14, 2022 and until a successor is appointed; b. the Board of Health for a term of office until November 14, 2022 and until a successor is appointed; c. the Exhibition Place Board of Governors for a term of office until November 14, 2022 and until a successor is appointed; d. the Campbell House Board of Management for a term of office until November 14, 2022 and until a successor is appointed; e. the Harbourfront Centre Board of Directors for a term of office until November 14, 2022 and until a successor is appointed; and f. the Waterfront Revitalization Corporation, as the…
